title: Reference-based blue animatronic v002 - editable rigged character test

acceptance_criteria.description: Front preview exists; all other requested previews must also pass worker gates
Four-view review: full body, rounded head, squat torso and segmented limbs broadly agree with reference proportions
Review two incisors, twin muzzle, striped glasses, ears, headphones, tuft, top hat, bow, pale bands and toes
Review separate editable parts and rigid armature; no missing or grossly detached major components
